steps.description: Sourced direct from trusted growers. Quality checks at intake — moisture, grade and visual inspection.

steps.title: Grading & cleaning

steps.title: Processing
steps.description: Controlled heat and time on automated production lines. Consistent texture, colour and taste across every batch.
